definitions.explanation: The act of interacting and maintaining relationships with other people. Can refer to one's general ability or willingness to socialize.

examples.japanese: {人付|ひとづ}き{合|あ}いが{苦手|にがて}だ。
{社会人|しゃかいじん}になると{人付|ひとづ}き{合|あ}いが{増|ふ}える。
examples.english: When you start working, social obligations increase.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{人付|ひとづ}き{合|あ}いがよく、{誰|だれ}とでもすぐに{仲良|なかよ}くなれる。
examples.english: He's good with people and can quickly become friends with anyone.

notes:
USAGE:
{人付|ひとづ}き{合|あ}い is a common word for describing how well or how much one socializes. It often appears with {苦手|にがて} (bad at), {上手|じょうず} (good at), or {広|ひろ}い (wide, extensive).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人付|ひとづ}き{合|あ}いが{苦手|にがて}だ (to be bad at socializing)
- {人付|ひとづ}き{合|あ}いがいい (to be sociable)
- {人付|ひとづ}き{合|あ}いが{広|ひろ}い (to have a wide social circle)
- {人付|ひとづ}き{合|あ}いを{避|さ}ける (to avoid socializing)
